exposure: distance from gestational sac to previous cesarean section scar
Distance from gestational sac to cesarean section scar
distance from the gestational sac to a previous cesarean section (CS) scar
outcome: placental abnormalities (morbidly adherent placenta, placenta previa)
cohort: 699 pregnant women with a history of a single cesarean delivery who underwent transvaginal ultrasound examination at 7-9 weeks of gestation
finding: Decreasing distance between the gestational sac and the cesarean section scar was associated with an increased incidence of placental abnormalities, particularly morbidly adherent placenta and placenta previa.
mod_finding: The study found no statistically significant difference in mode of delivery among the subgroups with varying distances between the gestational sac and the cesarean section scar.
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth: 39.0 weeks (range, 38.1-39.9 weeks)
